name: Riverside Landing Park
inclusion_evidence: sccmo.org Riverside Landing page: 13 large (54') + 5 small (34') electric concrete-pad RV sites, reservable, operating
waterfront_evidence: waterfront 'riverview' assessed in commit e051830 (Audit all 57 MO on-water designations against satellite imagery); on-water value recorded at that commit (no separate per-entry evidence string)
note: St. Charles County Parks campground on the Mississippi River with 18 electric concrete RV pads (13 large 54-ft, 5 small 34-ft; 20/30/50A) and a dump station; reservable, 2-night minimum; park water is non-potable. --Claude

name: Evening Star RV Park
inclusion_evidence: Operator rates.html: 42 full-hookup RV sites, nightly $40/night 2-night-min (plus monthly options), Stockton Lake Dadeville -> transient RV campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 37.5396,-93.7539: RV rows in open gravel lot; small farm ponds ~200-300m NE, sites not on water
note: Park ~2 mi from Stockton Lake's Mutton Creek area with 42 full-hookup sites (30/50A), bathhouse, laundry and a fishing pond; reservable. --Claude

name: Five Branches Camper Park
inclusion_evidence: Operator 5branches.com: 'OPEN 2026 SEASON 5/16-9/8', lists RV Camping with park map -> operating drive-in RV campground
waterfront_evidence: waterfront 'riverfront' assessed in commit 1ca1bea (Add 60 CO private campgrounds (commercial RV parks + 1 Hipcamp)); on-water value recorded at that commit (no separate per-entry evidence string)
note: Family-owned private park (since 1995) on the south end of Vallecito Lake where the Pine/Los Pinos River enters, ~15 mi N of Bayfield. 90+ RV sites plus tent sites, cabins and 9 park models; full hookups, 30-amp only (no 50-amp), no concrete pads and no pull-throughs (back-in 'wilderness' sites). Max RV length ~40 ft. Riverside Drive sites along the Pine River; Lakefront Drive sites face Vallecito Lake but sit behind a drawdown flat at low water. Seasonal: ~mid-May to early September (2026 season 5/16-9/8). 4-night minimum stay. Nightly transient camping, reservable online. --Claude

name: Oscoda County Park
inclusion_evidence: Firefly reservation portal lists Electric 30/50A + Water/Electric RV site types plus tent sites -> real drive-in RV county campground on Mio Pond
waterfront_evidence: audited 2026-06 (MI local evidence-gate sweep, commit 4e31287); waterfront 'lakeview' set by that satellite/per-site-map sweep (per-entry bucket detail in the commit message)
note: Oscoda County park on the AuSable River backwaters (Mio Pond) at Mio. 65 modern (30/50A electric) + 88 rustic sites plus a camping cabin; open ~Apr 15-Nov 30. Reservable online (Firefly) or by phone; 3-night minimum. --Claude

name: Barnes Park Campground (Antrim County Park)
inclusion_evidence: Antrim County parks page: electric + rustic drive-in sites, bathhouses, dump, reservable via Campspot (Memorial Day-Oct) -> real RV campground
waterfront_evidence: audited 2026-06 (MI local evidence-gate sweep, commit 4e31287); waterfront 'coastal woods' set by that satellite/per-site-map sweep (per-entry bucket detail in the commit message)
note: Antrim County park on Grand Traverse Bay (Lake Michigan) near Eastport, ~0.6 mi W of US-31/M-88. Electric and rustic wooded sites with Lake Michigan beach access, two modern bathhouses, trails; reservation required ($10 fee, 3-night min). Reservable via Campspot. --Claude

name: Millbrook Campground
inclusion_evidence: Operator site: RV full-hookup sites + tent sites W/E, bring-your-own RV permitted, online nightly booking, 2026 season -> real operating RV campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 44.8890,-72.4289: in-town/residential setting, sites along road; no significant water adjacent
note: Small private campground at 1184 VT-100, Westfield, on Mill Brook near Jay Peak. ~34 sites in a one-way loop: RV full-hookup, tent (water+electric), plus some designated seasonal; swimming pond on-site. Primarily transient/nightly (online date-range booking, 2-night min); RV full-hookup ~$41, tent ~$29 (+9% VT tax). Max vehicle ~37 ft. Free showers/WiFi. Open ~first Sat in May - second Mon in Oct. Under new ownership 2026 (Corey Alix). --Claude

name: Davidson's Countryside Campground
inclusion_evidence: Operator davidsonscamp.com: 2026 nightly RV rates listed (W/E field $55-60, W/S/30A $60), Check Availability online -> transient RV campground currently operating
waterfront_evidence: waterfront 'riverfront' assessed in commit 32ea296 (Audit all 47 NH waterfront designations against the gate); on-water value recorded at that commit (no separate per-entry evidence string)
note: Private family campground on the Pemigewasset River, ~3 mi from I-93 Exit 23, Bristol. ~99 RV sites (sources cite up to 152 total incl. tent); primitive tent, water/electric field & wooded, and water/sewer/30-amp (some 50-amp) sites. Big-rig friendly, many take slide-outs. Pool, private river beach, boat launch/rentals, store, laundry. Open ~May 15-Oct 15. Both seasonal and nightly transient; reservations by phone/email only (no online booking), 2-night minimum, 2026 nightly $48-$60. --Claude

name: Goethe Trailhead Ranch
inclusion_evidence: Operator ocalatrailsrvcamping.com: 'NOW TAKING RESERVATIONS FOR 2026', general RV+horse park (with or without horses), short/extended RV stays -> not equestrian-only, operating
waterfront_evidence: satellite at 29.1980,-82.5780: RV/equestrian sites in open pasture by Goethe SF, no water body present
note: General RV campground at 9171 SE CR 337, Dunnellon, near Goethe State Forest trails (has equestrian stalls/arena but is a full RV park, not equestrian-only). 73 full-hookup large RV sites (40x60), 30/50 amp, bathhouse, pool, dog park; rental cabins. Reservation only, 2-night minimum; $75/night. Opened 2007.

name: Sentinel Oaks RV Park
waterfront_evidence: default-down (no water near campground): Inland pine woods off Hwy 249, no water body nearby -> not waterfront
inclusion_evidence: Operator site: full-hookup back-in RV park with 45-50 ft pads (easily fits 23-ft rig), nightly (3-night min) -> real transient drive-in RV park.
note: New wooded RV park near Pinehurst/Magnolia NW of Houston; large 45-50 ft back-in full-hookup 30/50-amp pads, picnic table at each site, 3-night minimum. Nightly ($55-65). --Claude

name: River Rock Camping & RV Park
waterfront_evidence: Esri (leaf-on) and PEMA 2021-23 (leaf-off) at 40.5431,-77.3898 both legibly show the front 'River Sites' row set ~30-45 m back from the Juniata behind a continuous 20-30 m riparian woodland belt of dense trunks and understory, not an open apron; the operator's stylized brochure map drawing sites 1-30 on the bank shows no treeline and is a forbidden overview-map basis
inclusion_evidence: Operator campsites + reservation pages (riverrockcamping.com): published nightly rates ($75/$85, 2-night minimum) and an 'Overnight' site type on the booking form alongside 'Seasonal', with a 76-site full-hookup park map -> real transient drive-in RV campground
note: Riverside RV park established 2023 on River Rd along the Juniata River, just upstream of Port Royal Speedway (golf-cart access to the track, so expect race-weekend demand). The operator's 2024 park map shows 76 numbered full-hookup sites in three rows around a one-way loop, plus park office, bath house, pump house and a river-access road and parking for boats and tubes. Both overnight and seasonal sites are sold: published nightly rates are $75 (campsite) and $85 (river site) with a 2-night minimum; seasonal is $3,500 ($3,900 riverside). Overnight booking is by request form or phone, not an instant online engine. RV Life 4*/$ -- its avg_rate is a 0 placeholder, not a real price (auto 9/2026). --Claude

name: The Groves of Michigan
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 500 m frame) at 42.0620,-84.2570: main-campground lanes in woods and open ground north of the entry road; the only water is an algae-choked creek pond south of that road (the road is the buffer) - not waterfront
inclusion_evidence: thegrovesofmichigan.com/reservations: regular (non-event) nightly camping $50 incl. fees/taxes for 30A + water, +$5 50A, 2-night min; campground-maps page: ~350 electric sites in the main campground -> real transient RV campground alongside its seasonal and event business; published base $50 (2026) <= $50; quality: not on RV Life, Good Sam unrated, Google Maps 4.5 over 31 reviews
note: Large campground and event grounds on 200+ acres across US-12/Brooklyn Hwy from Michigan International Speedway (13500 US-12, Brooklyn); a main campground of ~350 electric (some water) sites in woods and open ground, plus ~1,300 rustic sites in two fields used on NASCAR and festival weekends. Takes regular nightly reservations as well as seasonals, open early May - late October. Non-event nights $50 incl. fees and taxes for 30-amp + water (+$5 for 50-amp), 2-night minimum; race and festival weekends priced separately and very busy. Pin is on the main campground (OSM still names it Juniper Hills). Not on RV Life; Google 4.5 over 31 reviews. --Claude

name: Eagles Landing Campground
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 600 m frame) at 44.4273,-103.5377: a row of gravel back-in pads and a row of cabins on open grassland north of Sturgis; open water ~300 m east beyond pasture; not waterfront
inclusion_evidence: campsturgis.com read 2026-10-03 ('Year-Round Camping In Sturgis SD', RV back-in gravel sites); ResNexus booking returned a $40.00/night standard rate for RV sites (cabins $70-110). Not on RV Life; Good Sam directory row (Good Sam overall 5.3) -> quality from Google 4.4 over 88 with phone; published rate <= $50 passes. Year-round, so not an event-only rally campground
note: Year-round campground on Avalanche Rd just north of Sturgis (2881 Avalanche Rd): back-in gravel RV sites around $40 a night, tent sites, cabins with baths; a Sturgis Rally base that is open all year. Online booking (ResNexus). --Claude
